Class InputPage

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.InputPage
final class InputPage extends Object
The InputPage class is one measurement of the unsent terminal page. PagePaint and the cursor both read this result, so a hard newline cannot disagree about the row count. A row that fills the width places the next character on the next row. When the next buffer character is a hard newline, that newline is that placement and does not add a second row. The cursor never rests in the last column. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#InputPage // @aa-sdd G-22 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Method Details

    • measure

      static InputPage measure(CharSequence text, int promptVis, int cols)
      The measure method reads the buffer once and records a cursor cell for every index. The width is at least 1. A negative prompt width is treated as 0. The prompt width itself wraps onto later rows before the first character. A hard newline is \n or \r. A hard newline moves to column 0 of the next row, unless the previous character already filled the width and marked that newline as absorbed. An absorbed newline does not add a second row. A character that fills the width sets the break flag and moves to the next row.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the buffer, including hard newlines.
      promptVis - The prompt width is the number of visible prompt columns before the buffer.
      cols - The column count is the wrap width. A value below 1 becomes 1.
      Returns:
      The return value is the measured page.

    • pageOpen

      static boolean pageOpen(CharSequence text)
      The pageOpen method reports whether the buffer contains a hard newline. Up and Down move a visual row when this method returns true. A buffer with no \n and no \r returns false.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the buffer to scan.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when Up and Down should move a visual row.

    • moveRow

      static int moveRow(InputPage page, int cursor, int delta)
      The moveRow method moves to the same column on the row delta steps away. The cursor index is clamped into the cell array. A target row before the first row or past the last row returns the clamped index. A target row with no cells returns the clamped index. The wanted column is clamped to the columns that exist on the target row. The return value is the last buffer index on that row whose column matches.
      Parameters:
      page - The page is the measured page.
      cursor - The cursor is the current buffer index.
      delta - The delta is the row step, usually -1 or 1.
      Returns:
      The return value is the buffer index to sit on.
